name: Historical median
description: Predicts the training-set PM10 median for every hour; no covariates.

name: Persistence
description: Predicts PM10 at t with the observed PM10 at t-1; deterministic.

name: ARX(1)
implementation: src/baselines/arx.py (statsmodels state-space AR(1) with exogenous regressors)
description: Dynamic regression on log PM10 with AR(1) errors, meteorological and Fourier exogenous regressors; rolling one-step-ahead forecasts (refit=False) with Kalman-filter forecast variance.

name: Lag-only Bayesian
description: Lognormal likelihood; linear predictor alpha + phi * lagged log PM10 only.

name: Meteorology-only Bayesian
description: Lognormal likelihood; linear predictor alpha + beta * standardized meteorology.

name: Meteorology + cyclic seasonality Bayesian
description: M1 plus 2-harmonic annual and daily Fourier seasonal terms.

name: Lag + meteorology + cyclic seasonality Bayesian
description: M2 plus phi * lagged log PM10; the full specification.
